 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

**The misspelled word is 'Calender'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Calendar'.**
 
• The word '**Calendar**' is a **noun** which means 'a chart or series of pages showing the days, weeks, and months of a particular year'. **(पंचांग)**
 
 
• **For Example -**
 
• The calendar on my desk helps me keep track of appointments.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be **'Calender'.**
